Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Serrin Galecrest. Character visual motifs: white-haired sailor swordsman with a collapsible wind vane shield and narrow curved blade; weather-map tapes attached to armor.
TOP LEFT: Weather Reading. Ability concept: Serrin sees recent incoming projectile headings as faint arrows; after narrowly dodging one, gains one Wind Notch (max 2).
TOP RIGHT: Compass Slash. Ability concept: cuts a 65-GU directional current across a target corridor for 2.2 s. Enemy **non-homing** projectiles crossing it are deflected up to 15Â°; allied shots get a 10% speed boost.
BOTTOM LEFT: Tack Change. Ability concept: spends a Wind Notch to rotate a current or quickly sidestep 28 GU perpendicular to its path. Cannot pass hard terrain.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Eye of the Crosswind. Ability concept: maps a 140-GU radius ring with four public directional wind channels for 4 s. Enemy projectile lanes become less reliable; walking normally still works. No blanket projectile deletion, knockup, or blink slashes.
